about: SAVED-SCRIPT UPGRADE IN THE DOOR'S WORKER (feat/pine-upgrade-worker, stacked on #2254): a stale saved script is translated again in the member door's worker at chart load, never on the chart's main thread; a worker that stopped leaves the row drawn as stored, never refused. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
